title: Reroute After a Landslide
story: A boulder now blocks yesterday's corridor. The displayed map includes the new obstruction.
lesson: Route planning must use the current obstacle map. An earlier valid path may now hit a wall.
objective: Return a shortest path on the updated grid, including endpoints. '#' includes newly fallen rocks. All goals are reachable.
sample: A blocked top aisle may require a lower detour.
hint: Run a fresh BFS on the supplied grid. Avoid caching a path across changed maps.
